note: Chronological win/loss streaks by exit_ts_ms. Not a promotion gate. MIN_EXCHANGE dust caveat on dollar PnL.
min_size_equity_caveat: Wallet equity / maximum drawdown under research_sizing MIN_EXCHANGE (minimum exchange size) on a large wallet is not tradable-edge evidence. Smooth curves are expected at dust size; do not treat them as deployable sizing.
equity_leverage_sizing_note: Research/display only: EQUITY_LEVERAGE_NOTIONAL notional = equity × equity_fraction × leverage (compound when enabled). wallet_return is valid under that mode. Live micro bots always use MIN_EXCHANGE (venue min qty per pair); never size live from wallet %. Peak concurrent margin utilisation is multi-book research stress. Never scale live size from a min-size research wallet % or equity-leverage study.

recommended_arm.name: loss_streak_cooloff_3
recommended_arm.rationale: Pause new entries after 3 closed consecutive losses (causal: only trades with exit before decision). Cuts churn during loss runs that hurt eth_multitrade_v1_1.
recommended_arm.economic: Avoid stacking books while the model is in a temporary failure mode.
